events.title: Brookfield, WI, US - June 19th thru 21st - K9 Ventures

details.title: Brookfield, WI, US – June 19th thru 21st – K9 Ventures
details.club_name: Lightyear Leap & Catch! Hosted by K9 Ventures
details.event_address: 503 N. Jackson Ave, Jefferson, WI 53549
details.additional_event_information_for_partici:
Come join us for a fun 3-day event to be part of the second annual “To Infinity and Beyond Classic-2026,” featuring the Lightyear Leap & Catch UpDog Disc Trial hosted by K9 Ventures!
We’re excited to host this disc event over three days at a beautiful site featuring both RV and tent camping. The grounds include shaded areas with trees lining the perimeter and a large grass field, with fencing along one side for added safety.
All games offered during the event will be Level 1, making it a great opportunity for teams of all experience levels. Additional events at the fairgrounds will include dock diving and flyball, creating a fun, multi-sport atmosphere.
Games will run on a time schedule similar to UPDIF-style events, with accommodations made for those participating in other dog sports on-site to avoid conflicts.
Awards will be given in three divisions:
Astronaut – Novice/Beginner
Space Traveler – Intermediate
Star Commander – Expert
Handlers may enter different dogs at the level appropriate for each team.
Volunteer giveaways for those who help support the event
RV and camping options will be listed on the entry form
Schedule:
Friday: Games begin approximately at 12:00 PM (depending on the number of entrants)
Saturday & Sunday:
Players meeting at 8:00 AM
Games begin at 8:30 AM
For additional information please contact: Katie Oilschlager @
info.k9ventures@gmail.com
Fillable- Lightyear Leap _ Catch UpDog Challenge Premium-June 2026
